crossRefs.note: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

translations.web: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
translations.bsb: On hearing these words, some of the people said, “This is truly the Prophet.”
translations.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
translations.asv: Some of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, This is of a truth the prophet.
